goals: Verify tryRun's basic execution and error propagation without retry configuration.
Verify tryRun's retry mechanism, including the number of retries and the delay between attempts, when configured.
activities: Define an error object for inner function failures.
Initialize a counter for inner function calls.
Call the 'tryRun' function without retry options.
Execute the provided inner function, incrementing the call counter.
The inner function invokes its callback with an error.
The 'tryRun' completion function asserts that the inner function was called once.
The 'tryRun' completion function asserts that the received error is the expected inner error.
Mark the test as complete.
Define retry options: 2 retries, 10ms timeout.
Initialize a counter for inner function calls.
Call the 'tryRun' function with retry options.
Execute the provided inner function, incrementing the call counter.
The inner function invokes its callback with no error.
The 'tryRun' completion function asserts that no error was received.
The 'tryRun' completion function asserts that the inner function was called once.
Mark the test as complete.
Initialize a counter for inner function calls.
Call the 'tryRun' function with retry options.
Repeatedly execute the provided inner function, incrementing the call counter and invoking its callback with an error.
The 'tryRun' completion function asserts that the received error is the expected inner error.
The 'tryRun' completion function asserts that the inner function was called 3 times.
Mark the test as complete.
Record the start time before calling 'tryRun'.
Call the 'tryRun' function with retry options.
Repeatedly execute the provided inner function, invoking its callback with an error.
Record the end time in the 'tryRun' completion function.
The 'tryRun' completion function asserts that the elapsed time is greater than 19ms.
